

```{bash}
cat > /scratch/midway3/temi/build_tfxcan_sif.sbatch <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=build_tfxcan_sif
#SBATCH --account=pi-haky
#SBATCH --partition=caslake
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --time=03:00:00
#SBATCH --output=/scratch/midway3/temi/tfxcan_container/build.%j.log

set -euo pipefail
module load apptainer/1.4.1

OUT=/scratch/midway3/temi/tfxcan_container
mkdir -p $OUT/cache $OUT/tmp
# keep apptainer's cache and build space off your (nearly full) home directory
export APPTAINER_CACHEDIR=$OUT/cache
export APPTAINER_TMPDIR=$OUT/tmp

cd /beagle3/haky/users/temi/projects/TFXcan-snakemake   # %files paths are relative to the repo root
apptainer build --fakeroot $OUT/tfxcan.sif container/tfxcan.def   # also runs the %test checks

ls -lh $OUT/tfxcan.sif
rm -rf $OUT/tmp/*   # build space no longer needed
EOF
sbatch /scratch/midway3/temi/build_tfxcan_sif.sbatch
```



```{bash}
apptainer exec --nv /scratch/midway3/temi/tfxcan_container/tfxcan.sif \
  python3 -c "import tensorflow as tf; print(tf.config.list_physical_devices('GPU'))"
```
